{{Conjecture|legends}}
Located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Shella Inion's]] '''hometown''' was the target of an [[Attack on Shella Inion's hometown|assault]] ordered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]<ref name="CSWE-Inion">{{CSWECite|II|103|Inion, Shella}}</ref> some [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CSWE-Mist">{{CSWECite|II|319|Mist}}</ref> Sarne would blame the attack on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="e">''[[Endgame]]''</ref>
